places.name: Xin Wang Hong Kong Café - Northpoint City
places.address: 930 Yishun Ave 2, #01-40 Northpoint City North Wing, Singapore 769098

reviews.author: zel
reviews.text:
It's ok... One of the few late night places in the area. You can't go wrong with toast. Chicken is decently nice, not too salty. Remember to ask for scallion ginger sauce.

Been here a few times and find the food to be hit and miss. Can avoid ordering any omelette over rice, they're so oily.

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.text:
Came for breakfast and the food took 45 mins to come out!! It was just porridge and hargao and beehoon… the beehoon was undercooked and bland… really terrible. Also, they ran out of kaya butter toast and carrot cake but only told us after we waited for 30 mins.. Staff was rushing and explaining things so rudely.

The place was so rowdy and noisy with children screaming everywhere.

reviews.author: G “Savoury Trails”
reviews.text:
Dropped by this cafe and ordered a few dishes to try. Service here was actually pretty solid, staff were attentive and everything came out quite quickly, which made the whole experience quite smooth.

Food wise, it was generally a nice meal. The creamy pasta was a bit on the bland side, could have had more flavour, but still alright overall.

Only thing is the noodle portion felt quite small for the price, which is slightly on the higher side, so it didn’t feel very worth it.

Still, a decent place to check out, especially for the service. Just don’t expect big portions.

reviews.author: CY
reviews.text:
First visit after reno. Place cleaner, wait staff that attended to me friendly and polite.

Ordered scrambled egg with XO pork pepper.
Literally drowning in oil.
Scooped out a good few spoonfuls of oil onto a saucer and try to eat my dinner....but gave up in the end.

reviews.author: Aw Hai
reviews.text: I've eaten Western food several times, and it's always been awful. I don't know if the meat isn't fresh or if it's the chef's skill level; the meat is dry and tasteless, and it's expensive. I only ate little not to waste, I just couldn't eat anymore.

reviews.author: Sal Zain
reviews.text:
Great experience and a wonderful family time! The staff were very courteous, and the head lady, Patima, was especially impressive. She is doing a great job and can always be seen on her toes, making sure everything runs smoothly.

Thank you, McDonald’s! Courteous and attentive staff can truly make or break a customer’s experience, and Patima and her team certainly made ours a memorable one.

reviews.author: Touristmouse
reviews.text:
I haven't visited Macdonald for ages, but since I got a coupon to claim 20-piece nuggets, I decided to use it at possibly the most beautiful outlet in Singapore. It certainly lives up to its reputation. My visit was in the late afternoon on Sunday, and there were plenty of seats available. I even snagged a cosy window seat where I caught up with some reading while enjoying my meal.

There is not much to say about fast food, but the coffee was better than expected and the limited edition criss-cut fries were crispy and addictive. Also, a shout-out to the crew members who helped me with an app payment issue (sorry I forgot your names). Your great service certainly gives me a reason to come back more often.

reviews.author: Lee
reviews.text: This is such a beautiful and clean McDonalds.  It would be the cleanest McDonalds I've attended anywhere in the world!  It was very nostalgic of the early days of McDonalds when the staff were constantly on the floor checking the cleanliness of the restaurant, cleaning tables and helping customers.  The burger came out very well prepared and fresh.  The Founding brothers of McDonalds would be very proud of this establishment!

reviews.author: Pascal W
reviews.text: One of the nicest McDonald’s restaurants in Singapore. Nice seating and friendly staff. Burger and fries tasted real good.

reviews.author: Nadir Zaraa
reviews.text:
Elias is an incredible leader and, above all, an amazing human being. He is genuinely kind, warm, extremely polite, and always smiling. His positive energy alone makes the experience so much more enjoyable.

What truly stands out is how much he cares about his customers. He personally checks on everyone, making sure each guest is satisfied and has everything they need. His kindness and genuine attention perfectly reflect the wonderful person he is.

I highly recommend this McDonald’s. It is by far the best McDonald’s I have ever visited in the world so far, and Elias is a big part of what makes it so special. A truly outstanding person and an exceptional customer experience!

places.name: OK Chicken Rice & Humfull Laksa (WH)
places.address: 1 Woodlands Height, #01-01 Koufu Group HQ, Singapore 737859

reviews.author: Grace
reviews.text: Fast delivery through foodpanda, but the order was missing chili sauce and one Coke. Worse, the chicken tasted bland like plain boiled meat and had an unpleasant smell—even soy sauce couldn't save it. What a disappointing $30 waste for lunch. Food standards have really dropped lately; no wonder shops are closing down. Reviews called this 'the best chicken rice,' which is shocking because it’s the worst we’ve ever had. The owner really needs to check their food quality. Paying good money for inedible food is disgusting. All go to rubbish bin!!

reviews.author: Jim Tay
reviews.text: Service with a smile! A big thank you to Ms. Hajak. So friendly! I definitely recommend this stall! The bowl of laksa is done very nicely. Great job!

reviews.author: ryska ??
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had such a wonderful experience at this chicken rice shop! The chicken rice was really delicious, flavourful, and satisfying. The chicken was tender and juicy, and everything tasted so fresh and well-prepared. You can really tell that care and effort go into making the food. The rice was fragrant and paired perfectly with the chicken and sauces. Honestly, every bite was so good, and I would definitely come back again for more! 😋🍚🐔

What made the experience even better was the staff! The worker was so, so nice, friendly, and welcoming. Their kindness and warm attitude made me feel comfortable and happy while ordering. It is always such a lovely feeling when you visit a food place and the staff treat you with genuine kindness. Good food is already a reason to return, but excellent service makes the whole experience even more memorable. ❤️

I really appreciate the effort the staff put into making customers feel welcomed and appreciated. It may seem like a small thing, but being served by someone who is genuinely nice can make such a big difference to the overall experience.

Overall, I highly recommend this chicken rice shop to anyone who loves good chicken rice and friendly service! The food is delicious, the service is wonderful, and the atmosphere makes you want to come back again. Definitely worth trying, and I will absolutely be returning in the future. Thank you to the staff for the amazing food and such a pleasant experience! 🥰 Highly recommended! 💯

reviews.author: siti nursyafiqah
reviews.text: Im a regular customer who always buy hum laksa with extra hum. The staff is super friendly! Good service,always give a smile although they look tired

reviews.author: Don Ng
reviews.text:
I’d like to share some feedback about my recent visit. I ordered chicken rice and was quite surprised by the pricing — it wasn’t clearly displayed, and I only found out the amount when paying. While I can afford it, the lack of transparency made it feel like a rip-off.

On top of that, the Malay lady staff who attended to me had a rather unpleasant attitude, which made the experience worse. I hope the stall can be more transparent with pricing and remind staff to treat customers respectfully. It’s not about the money, but about fairness and service.

See the photos for yourself.

places.name: Ya Kun Kaya Toast (Shell @ Jalan Ahmad Ibrahim)

reviews.author: Phang Kaijie
reviews.text:
I arrived at 7am sharp because Google lists the opening time as 7am, intending to order breakfast. However, the staff member told me she had just arrived and was not ready to take orders yet. When I asked what time she would be ready, she said 20 minutes.

I am not sure if this is how it is supposed to be, but if the stated opening time is 7am, I believe customers should be able to order at 7am. Otherwise, the opening time should reflect when the store is actually ready to serve customers. It was a disappointing start to the morning.

I hope the management can look into this. If unable to sell at the stated opening time, please adjust the timing accordingly so as not to waste customers' trips down.

reviews.author: spendntravel
reviews.text: Thanks lady making a good coffee to kick start my day especially it’s good location at Jurong/Tuas industrial area.

reviews.author: Stanley Teo
reviews.text:
Driving past daily for years, but only patronized handful of times.  Always full of flies.
This week ordered egg peanut butter toast set for breakfast, instant diarrhea by 10am.  Still lots of flies this visit.  Have to conclude it's this store hygiene issue.  Server was friendly and nice.

reviews.author: Muhammad Rahmat Omar
reviews.text: The Ya Kun Kaya Toast inside Shell is a great spot for a quick and convenient breakfast, especially for drivers working around Jurong Port and Jurong Island. Its strategic location makes it easy to drop by, grab your food, and be on your way. Perfect for a quick pick-me-up before starting the day!

reviews.author: Edna Chew
reviews.text:
Is the egg been cooked? Half boiled? Aunty said :yes
After she peeled off, i asked again, u sure cooked???
Aunty yes, can  eat...
Once i eat, some part of egg still cold🙄🙄 the egg not even half boiled!!
Feedback to aunty, she not even look at me!!
I HOPE MY TUMMY WONT PAIN AFTER THIS!

reviews.author: Giang Ta Quynh
reviews.text: I ordered their signature roasted pork banh mi and it was hugeeee and delicious! The coconut cafe tasted just right for my taste too. Price is definitely reasonable. Overall, the place looked clean, cozy and well-decorated.

reviews.author: Mark Ong
reviews.text:
Although it's slightly visible from the main street, most folks may not know this place as it's tuck inside a condominium. When I go there the decorations is nice and warm but slightly messy with personal stuff all over the tiny cafe tables and chairs. The one manning the store spoke limited English which is my delight as I know ethnic food like these will somewhat be authentic. Interesting selection of bahn mi , prices are reasonable in Singapore standard.  Chat with the owner when she came in.  Very warm and friendly owner. Spoke excellent English. Food wise I wouldn't say it is the best or the most sumptuous bahn mi in town but it's unique texture and taste has a place in my heart.  3 items was ordered that day. Beef and cheese bahn mi , signature pork version and 2 Vietnamese spring rolls.  Spring rolls are generous with big shrimp in it . Taste refreshing with the fish sauce.
Efforts are felt in the food production. My beef patty has tastes of sugar cane marinade into it. Very unique. Bread are crispy and fresh. Signature pork version is good on its own. Although nowhere near the generous topping of Saigon's version, it has its own flair . The texture here is much chewy with more meat fiber.  There are slight variations of mayonnaise use and chilli sauce included.  Overall a good authentic experience. I desire to try the roast pork bahn mi on the menu.

reviews.author: Hanxing Xu
reviews.text: Decided to try this store by ordering takeaway. WhatsApped their phone number and they prepared my order very efficiently! Egg Banh Mi and Grilled Pork Banh Mi were both huge with bursting flavours. Would definitely come back again whenever we're craving Vietnamese.

reviews.author: Ming Wei Lee
reviews.text: a cosy little space within the Kovan area and nestled inside the Trilive Condominium, this Vietnamese eatery is newly open and serves up some authentic Vietnamese delights most notably Banh Mi. They have several meat options from meat balls to grill pork or roasted pork. Worth a visit for those staying in the area. Think they are on grab and food panda too.

reviews.author: Daniel Leung
reviews.text: Enjoyed a lovely bfast at this quaint cafe conveniently located in kovan. Food was great, service was amazing and loving the art on the wall. I cant believe we had so much food and drinks and takeaway and bill came out to be really affordable. Will go back regularly and glad to have found one of the best Banh Mi in town.
